So good we returned the next day!
Aug 2026 • Couples
The title says it all. In Vietnam my wife and I are referencing vegetarian fare. And if you are a vegetarian or with a vegetarian, this restaurant is a gem. About five minutes walk from Da Lat Centre. The vegetarian coconut tofu curry is made from fresh coconut and the sauce is silky smooth. Very fragrant and a hit of heat. Another couple of outstanding dishes is the morning glory stir fried with garlic and peanuts and the spicy lemongrass tofu. I hope you enjoy this restaurant as much as we did!

Medicore meal, Tourist trap if you are from Singapore, Malaysia and Southeast Asia
Jul 2025 • Friends
We went for lunch and had Curry Chicken, Shrimp in Coconut and Morning Glory.
We are from Southeast Asia and mind you the curry is not at all authentic. It was last minute assembly of coconut milk, curry, chicken meat in small pieces and well cooked potatoes and carrot. This is nothing like that curry we have in Southeast Asia where curries are cooked with their ingreidnet for some time. This is instant curry.

It was a very medicore meal.

Lovely dinner spot
May 2025 • Couples
Absolutely loved this place! Cozy, clean, and with a calm, welcoming vibe. The staff were kind and attentive without being pushy. The food was fresh and full of flavor — we especially enjoyed the chicken in coconut curry. The sauce was rich and creamy, with just the right amount of spice, and the chicken was perfectly tender. Prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere makes you want to linger. A great spot for authentic Vietnamese cuisine in Da Lat — highly recommended!
